theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_sd_lipschitz_extend
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (K : NNReal), LipschitzOnWith K ψ S → ∃ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, LipschitzWith (NNReal.sqrt P * K) φ ∧ EqOn φ ψ S
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
